name: work-finder
description: Finds the next ticket to work on from the Linear backlog, confirms it with you, verifies you're in the right repo, gathers context, plans the change, then implements it on a branch named with the Linear ticket number, committing and opening a PR that reference the ticket.
welcomeMessage: I'll pull the next ticket from the Linear backlog, confirm it with you, and help plan and implement it. Say 'go' or ask me to check the backlog to start.
